usedFor: Copper holds leads, people and companies, and Campaign Monitor receives them as subscribers through “Add Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Copper, then “Add Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor
bestTemplate.why: A new lead joins a chosen list, with custom field data if you map it.

watchOut: “Unsubscribe” in Campaign Monitor removes a subscriber from a list, so pair it with “New Lead” only on purpose.
